questions.stem: When a person is dehydrated, what happens to their urine?

options.text: It becomes more dilute and larger in volume
It stays the same because the kidneys always produce the same amount
It becomes more concentrated and smaller in volume
It stops being produced entirely until water is consumed

questions.explanation: When dehydrated, more ADH is released, causing more water to be reabsorbed from the collecting duct. This means the urine produced is more concentrated (darker) and smaller in volume, conserving water.
